windows.60: Over the past 60 days, visitors have frequently commented on the food quality at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, with several noting issues related to the menu range and meal preparation. One critical review highlighted dissatisfaction with the limited menu options and the quality of specific items like potato salad and grilled cheese. Wait times and service were mentioned less often but still appeared in some feedback. Overall, the average rating remains positive, but attention to the food offerings and variety could improve the visitor experience.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many guests found the menu limited and the food quality below expectations, with complaints about portion sizes, pricing, and preparation. Service problems were noted, including long wait times and periods when kitchen orders were not being taken. While the library itself receives positive remarks, the cafe’s current food offerings and service logistics need attention to improve visitor satisfaction.
